title: valerianella olitoria
intro: Valerianella olitoria, commonly known as corn salad or lamb's lettuce, is a type of leafy green vegetable. It is rich in nutrients and antioxidants, providing numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of Valerianella olitoria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's high content of vitamins A and C, as well as minerals like potassium and iron, make it a valuable addition to a healthy diet.
